observation_summary: The toDouble() method returns -Infinity instead of 0.0 when the Dfp object represents zero.
reasoning_summary: The Dfp.toDouble() method incorrectly maps a Dfp zero value to a double representation of negative infinity. According to the bug report and IEEE 754 standards, a double with an exponent of 0xFFF and a significand of 0 represents infinity, not zero. The implementation fails to correctly handle the zero case, resulting in an invalid conversion where the internal Dfp zero state is misinterpreted as -Infinity.
